title: Remove the variadic fcntl P/Invoke from DaemonProcessIsolation.PreventParentStreamInheritance (Darwin arm64 ABI hazard)
outcome: Unix branch of PreventParentStreamInheritance deleted; design.md sentence kept because Unix redirection severs caller stdout/stderr by construction. Evidence: on Darwin arm64 variadic arguments are passed on the stack, so a fixed-signature fcntl(int,int,int) P/Invoke makes F_SETFD read garbage. Land before any macOS work (see w-023345bfea87).
acceptance: DaemonProcessIsolation has no fcntl P/Invoke; Unix launch relies on RedirectStandardOutput/Error dup2 plus O_CLOEXEC for inheritance severing; Windows keeps SetHandleInformation; cold CLI/daemon launch tests pass on Windows and Linux

completion.summary: Removed the unsafe Unix fixed-signature fcntl path while retaining Windows handle isolation.
